<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-Hant-TW">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>玉山證券｜美股複委託</title>
<meta name="description" content="玉山證券美股複委託：手續費率 0.08%、支援盤前盤後交易、一站式 App，資金留在台灣更安心。立即線上開戶。">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+TC:wght@400;500;700;900&family=Outfit:wght@500;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<!--
  ※ 手續費率 0.08%、定期定額每期 US$100（不提供碎股）、新戶活動（2026/10/1–12/31）依專案提供資料撰寫；
    上線前請經法遵審核。搜尋關鍵字「[待確認]」可找到仍需確認的文字。
-->
<style>
:root{
  --green:#00877A;         /* 玉山主色（深綠） */
  --green-2:#00A496;       /* 玉山亮綠 */
  --green-soft:#E6F5F3;
  --mint:#CFF0EB;
  --sun:#FFB81C;           /* 輔色：暖陽黃 */
  --sun-soft:#FFF4D9;
  --coral:#FF6B4A;
  --ink:#16302C;
  --ink-2:#4A5F5B;
  --line:#DCE7E5;
  --bg:#F7FAF9;
  --card:#FFFFFF;
  --up:#E5484D;            /* 台灣習慣：紅漲 */
  --down:#13A06B;          /* 綠跌 */
  --radius:20px;
  --shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,80,72,.08);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:"Noto Sans TC",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);line-height:1.7;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{max-width:100%}
.num{font-family:"Outfit","Noto Sans TC",sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.wrap{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
section{padding:88px 0}
.eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:99px;margin-bottom:14px}
h2.title{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,40px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:12px}
.lead{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:17px;max-width:640px}
.center{text-align:center}.center .lead{margin:0 auto}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;border-radius:99px;padding:14px 28px;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;border:0;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-primary{background:var(--sun);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(255,184,28,.35)}
.btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(255,184,28,.5)}
.btn-ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.btn-green{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ===== Nav ===== */
.nav{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:50;transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.nav.solid{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);box-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:68px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#fff;transition:color .3s}
.nav.solid .logo{color:#00A19B}
.logo-svg{display:block;height:36px;width:auto}
.logo-svg .in{fill:var(--green);transition:fill .3s}
.nav.solid .logo-svg .in{fill:#fff}
.logo-sub{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;padding-left:12px;border-left:1.5px solid currentColor;line-height:1.2}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:26px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.nav.solid .nav-links{color:var(--ink-2)}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--sun)}
.nav .btn{padding:10px 20px;font-size:14px}
@media (max-width:1040px){.nav-links{display:none}}

/* ===== Hero ===== */
.hero{position:relative;padding:150px 0 170px;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;
  background:radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 85% 10%,rgba(255,184,28,.25),transparent 60%),
             linear-gradient(135deg,#006E63 0%,#00877A 45%,#00A496 100%)}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -10% -1px;height:120px;background:var(--bg);clip-path:ellipse(70% 100% at 50% 100%)}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.6vw,60px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.2;margin:14px 0 18px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hero h1 .hl{color:var(--sun);position:relative;white-space:nowrap}
.hero p.sub{font-size:18px;opacity:.92;max-width:520px;margin-bottom:28px}
.hero .chip{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:99px;font-size:14px}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sun);box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,184,28,.7);animation:pulse 1.8s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(255,184,28,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,184,28,0)}}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-stats{display:flex;gap:34px;margin-top:40px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-stats b{display:block;font-size:30px;font-weight:800;color:var(--sun)}
.hero-stats span{font-size:13px;opacity:.85}
/* Phone mock */
.phone{width:290px;margin:0 auto;background:#0D1F1C;border-radius:42px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transform:rotate(4deg);animation:float 6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:rotate(4deg) translateY(-12px)}}
.screen{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--ink);padding:22px 18px}
.screen .bal{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.screen .bal b{display:block;font-size:26px;color:var(--ink)}
.screen .gain{color:var(--up);font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.mini-chart{margin:12px 0 14px}
.hold{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px}
.hold .tk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.hold .ic{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;color:#fff}
.hold small{color:var(--ink-2);display:block;font-size:11px}
.screen .buy{margin-top:12px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;text-align:center;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
@media (max-width:900px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.phone{display:none}}


/* ===== Market clock ===== */
.clock-bar{margin-top:-40px;position:relative;z-index:3}
.clock{background:var(--card);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:24px;align-items:center;padding:22px 28px}
.clock .status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-weight:700;font-size:18px}
.clock .light{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%}
.clock .times{display:flex;gap:30px;color:var(--ink-2);font-size:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.clock .times b{color:var(--ink);font-size:20px;display:block}
@media (max-width:760px){.clock{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:left}}

/* ===== Worries (illustration) ===== */
.worries{padding-top:20px}
.ans-card{transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.ans-card:hover{transform:translateX(4px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,80,72,.14)}
.ans-card .go{margin-left:auto;flex:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--green);white-space:nowrap}
.worrygrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center}
.persona{position:relative;padding:112px 0 10px}
.persona::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:70px 6% 0;border-radius:50% 50% 28px 28px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--mint),var(--green-soft));z-index:0}
.persona img{position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;height:auto;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 18px rgba(0,60,54,.15))}
.speech{position:absolute;z-index:2;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,60,54,.14);white-space:nowrap;animation:bob 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.speech::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-7px;width:14px;height:14px;background:#fff;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.sp1{top:54px;left:0}.sp1::after{left:28px}
.sp2{top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);animation-delay:1.2s}.sp2::after{left:calc(50% - 7px)}
.sp3{top:54px;right:0;animation-delay:2.4s}.sp3::after{right:30px}
@keyframes bob{50%{translate:0 -6px}}
.answers{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:22px}
.ans-card{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;background:var(--card);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-left:5px solid var(--green)}
.ans-card .q{font-size:26px}
.ans-card b{display:block;font-size:16px}
.ans-card small{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:14px}
@media (max-width:900px){.worrygrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}.persona{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;width:100%}}
@media (max-width:520px){.persona{padding-top:150px}.persona::before{top:110px}.speech{font-size:12px;padding:7px 10px}.sp1{top:46px}.sp3{top:94px}}

/* ===== Extended hours ===== */
.hours{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5.5fr 6.5fr 4fr;gap:8px;margin-top:40px}
.seg{border-radius:18px;padding:22px 20px;position:relative}
.seg h4{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:4px}
.seg b{display:block;font-size:24px;font-weight:800}
.seg small{font-size:13px;opacity:.75}
.seg.pre{background:var(--sun-soft);border:2px solid var(--sun)}
.seg.reg{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.seg.post{background:var(--sun-soft);border:2px solid var(--sun)}
.seg .badge{position:absolute;top:-12px;left:18px;background:var(--sun);color:var(--ink);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:99px}
.seg.on{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(229,72,77,.35)}
.seg.on h4::after{content:" ● 進行中";color:var(--up);font-size:12px}
.seg.reg.on h4::after{color:#FFD1D2}
.hours-why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:22px}
.hours-why div{background:var(--card);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hours-why b{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.hours-why span{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-2)}
@media (max-width:760px){.hours,.hours-why{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hours{gap:16px}}

/* ===== Why US ===== */
.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:44px}
.why-card{background:var(--card);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:28px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s}
.why-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px)}
.why-card .big{font-size:40px;font-weight:800;color:var(--green);line-height:1.1}
.why-card .big small{font-size:18px}
.why-card h3{font-size:18px;margin:10px 0 6px}
.why-card p{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-2)}
@media (max-width:960px){.why-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:520px){.why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.brands{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:34px}
.brands span{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.brands span b{color:var(--ink)}

/* ===== Calculator ===== */
.calc-sec{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg),var(--green-soft))}
.calc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,380px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:28px;margin-top:40px}
.calc .panel{min-width:0}
.kpi b{font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,24px) !important;word-break:break-all}
.panel{background:var(--card);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:28px}
.field{margin-bottom:22px}
.field label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px}
.field label output{color:var(--green);font-family:Outfit,sans-serif}
input[type=range]{width:100%;appearance:none;height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--line);outline:none}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{appearance:none;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);border:4px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2);cursor:pointer}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);border:4px solid #fff;cursor:pointer}
.pills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.pill{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-size:14px;transition:.2s}
.pill small{display:block;color:var(--ink-2);font-size:12px}
.pill.on{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--green)}
/* picker */
.picker{margin-top:40px}
.ptabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ptab{font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:10px 20px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.ptab.on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
.pills.etf{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pills.etf .pill{padding:14px 16px;font-weight:700}
.mapLayout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);gap:22px;align-items:start}
.mapFrame{background:var(--bg);border-radius:18px;padding:12px}
.usMap{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.usMap .rg{cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .25s;opacity:.55}
.usMap .rg.on{opacity:1}
.mapPin{cursor:pointer}
.mapPin circle{fill:var(--green);stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3;transition:.2s}
.mapPin text{fill:#fff;font:700 14px Outfit,sans-serif;text-anchor:middle;pointer-events:none}
.mapPin.on circle{fill:var(--sun)}
.mapPin.on text{fill:var(--ink)}
.regionSelect{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.regionBtn{font:inherit;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 6px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:.2s}
.regionBtn b{display:block;font-size:15px}
.regionBtn small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-2);line-height:1.3}
.regionBtn.on{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--green)}
.rdot{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;margin-bottom:2px}
.rdot.west{background:#5CC7B7}.rdot.midwest{background:#7DBCE0}.rdot.south{background:#F5B533}.rdot.east{background:#FF9277}
.cpHead h3{font-size:19px}
.cpHead small{display:block;color:var(--ink-2);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:12px}
.companyList{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;max-height:380px;overflow:auto;padding:2px}
.companyCard{font:inherit;text-align:left;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s}
.companyCard:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,80,72,.1)}
.companyCard.on{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--green)}
.logoBox{flex:0 0 36px;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.logoBox img{width:22px;height:22px;object-fit:contain;position:relative;z-index:1;background:#fff}
.logoBox i{position:absolute;font-style:normal;font:800 12px Outfit,sans-serif;color:var(--green)}
.cc{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.cc .tk{font:800 12px Outfit,sans-serif;color:var(--green);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cc b{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.3}
.cc small{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-2);line-height:1.35}
.tier{font:700 10px "Noto Sans TC",sans-serif;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:99px}
.tier.g{background:#FFE3E4;color:#C4363B}.tier.s{background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green)}.tier.v{background:var(--sun-soft);color:#9A6A00}
.selbar{margin-top:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 18px}
.selbar span{font-size:13px;opacity:.7}
.selbar b{font-size:18px}
.selbar em{font-style:normal;font-size:13px;background:var(--sun);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:99px}
@media (max-width:960px){.mapLayout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pills.etf{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.companyList{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));max-height:none}}
@media (max-width:520px){.companyList{grid-template-columns:1fr}.regionSelect{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.result-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:18px}
.kpi{background:var(--bg);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px}
.kpi span{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.kpi b{display:block;font-size:24px;font-weight:800}
.kpi.main{background:var(--green);color:#fff}.kpi.main span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.kpi .up{color:var(--up)}
#chart{width:100%;height:280px;display:block}
.legend{display:flex;gap:18px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2);margin-top:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.legend i{display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:-1px}
.coffee{margin-top:16px;background:var(--sun-soft);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 18px;font-size:15px}
.disclaim{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-2);margin-top:12px}
@media (max-width:1060px){.calc{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:960px){.result-top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.kpi.main{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* ===== Compare ===== */
.cmp{margin-top:40px;background:var(--card);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
.cmp table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:15px}
.cmp th,.cmp td{padding:18px 20px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.cmp thead th{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-weight:700}
.cmp thead th.us{background:var(--green)}
.cmp td.us{background:var(--green-soft);font-weight:700;color:var(--green)}
.cmp td:first-child{font-weight:700;width:22%}
.cmp tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.ok{color:var(--green);font-weight:900}.no{color:#B9C4C2}
@media (max-width:700px){.cmp{overflow-x:auto}.cmp table{min-width:620px}}

/* ===== Advantages ===== */
.adv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:44px}
.adv{background:var(--card);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:30px 26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.adv .ico{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--green-soft);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
.adv h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:8px}
.adv p{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:14.5px}
.adv-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--green);border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transition:color .2s}
.adv-link:hover{color:var(--green-2)}
.adv .tag{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;background:var(--sun);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px}
.adv.feature{grid-column:1/-1;background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--green),var(--green-2));color:#fff;display:flex;gap:30px;align-items:center}
.adv.feature p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.adv.feature .ico{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.adv.feature .big{font-size:56px;font-weight:800;color:var(--sun);line-height:1;white-space:nowrap}
@media (max-width:960px){.adv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.adv.feature{grid-column:1/-1}}
@media (max-width:600px){.adv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.adv.feature{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}}

/* ===== Quiz ===== */
.quiz-sec{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.quiz-sec .eyebrow{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:var(--sun)}
.quiz-sec .lead{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.quiz{max-width:720px;margin:40px auto 0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:24px;padding:34px}
.qbar{height:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:9px;margin-bottom:24px;overflow:hidden}
.qbar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--sun);width:0;transition:width .4s}
.qstep{font-size:13px;color:var(--sun);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.qtitle{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:20px}
.qopts{display:grid;gap:12px}
.qopt{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;text-align:left;font:inherit;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.qopt:hover{border-color:var(--sun);background:rgba(255,184,28,.12)}
.qres{text-align:center;animation:pop .5s}
@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.92);opacity:0}}
.qres .emoji{font-size:64px}
.qres h3{font-size:28px;color:var(--sun);margin:6px 0}
.qres .picks{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0}
.qres .picks .pick{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 14px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;transition:.2s}
.qres .picks .pick:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.qres .picks .pick.on{border-color:var(--sun);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,184,28,.35)}
.selbar.flash{animation:flash 1.6s ease}
@keyframes flash{0%,60%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,184,28,.9)}30%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(255,184,28,.5)}100%{box-shadow:none}}
.qres .picks small{display:block;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink-2);font-size:11px}
.qres .row{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}

/* ===== Mission / Promo ===== */
.promo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.mission{display:grid;gap:14px}
.ms{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;background:var(--card);border-radius:18px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-left:6px solid var(--green)}
.ms .n{flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:18px}
.ms h4{font-size:17px}
.ms p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.ms .rw{margin-left:auto;flex:none;background:var(--sun-soft);color:#9A6A00;font-weight:800;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;text-align:center}
.countdown{display:flex;gap:10px;margin:22px 0}
.countdown div{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 0;width:68px;text-align:center}
.countdown b{display:block;font-size:26px;font-family:Outfit}
.countdown span{font-size:11px;opacity:.7}
@media (max-width:860px){.promo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ===== Steps ===== */
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:44px;counter-reset:s}
.step{background:var(--card);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:30px 26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative}
.step::before{counter-increment:s;content:"0" counter(s);font-family:Outfit;font-size:54px;font-weight:800;color:var(--mint);position:absolute;top:10px;right:22px}
.step h3{font-size:19px;margin:22px 0 8px;position:relative}
.step p{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:14.5px;position:relative}
.step .time{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px}
.prep{margin-top:22px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink-2);font-size:15px}
.prep b{color:var(--ink)}
@media (max-width:860px){.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ===== Voices ===== */
.voices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:40px}
.voice{background:var(--card);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.voice p{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:16px}
.who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:14px}
.av{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;color:#fff}
.who small{display:block;color:var(--ink-2)}
@media (max-width:860px){.voices{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ===== FAQ ===== */
.faq{max-width:820px;margin:40px auto 0}
.faq-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}
.faq-tabs button{font:inherit;font-size:14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:8px 18px;cursor:pointer}
.faq-tabs button.on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
details{background:var(--card);border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,80,72,.05);overflow:hidden}
summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:20px 56px 20px 24px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;position:relative}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
summary::after{content:"+";position:absolute;right:22px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:20px;transition:transform .3s}
details[open] summary::after{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg)}
details .ans{padding:0 24px 22px;color:var(--ink-2);font-size:15px}
details .ans ul{padding-left:20px}

/* ===== Final CTA ===== */
.final{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#006E63,#00A496);color:#fff;text-align:center;border-radius:32px;padding:64px 24px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.final::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:360px;height:360px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,184,28,.25);top:-160px;right:-100px}
.final h2{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,42px);font-weight:900;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative}
.final p{opacity:.9;margin-bottom:28px;position:relative}
.final .btn{position:relative}
footer{background:#0F2522;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);font-size:12.5px;padding:40px 0 100px;line-height:1.9}
footer b{color:#fff}

/* ===== Sticky mobile CTA ===== */
.sticky-cta{position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:60;display:none;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);transform:translateY(140%);transition:transform .4s}
.sticky-cta.show{transform:none}
.sticky-cta small{display:block;opacity:.7;font-size:12px}
.sticky-cta .btn{padding:10px 18px;font-size:14px}
@media (max-width:760px){.sticky-cta{display:flex}}

/* campaign */
.prize{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin:18px 0}
.prize div{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:16px 18px}
.prize b{display:block;font-size:20px;color:var(--sun)}
.prize span{font-size:13px;opacity:.8}
.ms .rw b{display:block;font-size:22px;line-height:1.1}
.bonus{margin-top:14px;background:var(--sun-soft);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 22px;font-size:14.5px}
.bonus h4{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:4px}
.bonus a{color:var(--green);font-weight:700}
</style>
</head>

<!-- ============ FAQ ============ -->
<section id="faq" style="padding-top:20px">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="center">
      <span class="eyebrow">FAQ</span>
      <h2 class="title">常見問題</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="faq">
      <div class="faq-tabs" id="faqTabs">
        <button class="on" data-f="all">全部</button>
        <button data-f="open">開戶</button>
        <button data-f="trade">交易</button>
        <button data-f="fee">費用與稅務</button>
      </div>
      <details data-c="open"><summary>什麼是複委託？</summary><div class="ans">複委託（受託買賣外國有價證券）是指投資人透過國內證券商，再委託國外券商買賣海外股票。你只需在台灣的證券商開戶，就能交易美股、ETF 等海外商品，並受台灣金融法規保障。</div></details>
      <details data-c="open"><summary>開立複委託帳戶需要準備什麼？</summary><div class="ans"><ul><li>年滿 20 歲之本國人（未滿 20 歲需法定代理人同意）</li><li>身分證及第二身分證明文件</li><li>本人銀行帳戶（建議玉山銀行台幣及外幣帳戶）</li></ul></div></details>
      <details data-c="open"><summary>我已經有玉山證券台股帳戶，還要重新開戶嗎？</summary><div class="ans">不需要重新開立證券戶，只需線上加開「複委託帳戶」即可。</div></details>
      <details data-c="trade"><summary>美股交易時間是什麼時候？</summary><div class="ans">美股一般交易時段為美東時間 09:30–16:00，換算台灣時間：<ul><li>夏令時間（約 3 月中至 11 月初）：21:30–隔日 04:00</li><li>冬令時間：22:30–隔日 05:00</li></ul>玉山證券另支援<b>盤前交易</b>（美東 04:00–09:30）與<b>盤後交易</b>（美東 16:00–20:00），交易時段更長；其餘時段可於 App 預約下單。</div></details>
      <details data-c="trade"><summary>定期定額最低要投多少？可以買碎股嗎？</summary><div class="ans">美股定期定額每期最低 US$100。目前不提供碎股交易，皆以整股方式買進。</div></details>
      <details data-c="trade"><summary>定期定額怎麼設定？可以隨時停扣嗎？</summary><div class="ans">於 App 選擇標的、扣款金額與扣款日即可完成設定，可隨時變更金額、暫停或終止扣款。</div></details>
      <details data-c="trade"><summary>美股有漲跌幅限制嗎？</summary><div class="ans">美股沒有每日漲跌幅限制，但設有熔斷機制。因波動可能較大，建議以分散與長期投資方式參與並設定好風險承受範圍。</div></details>
      <details data-c="fee"><summary>交易手續費怎麼計算？</summary><div class="ans">玉山證券複委託手續費率為成交金額的 0.08%。</div></details>
      <details data-c="fee"><summary>美股股利要繳稅嗎？</summary><div class="ans">台灣投資人領取美股現金股利，一般會先被美國預扣 30% 股利稅；海外所得（如買賣價差）則依台灣最低稅負制規定，海外所得達 100 萬元以上須計入基本所得額申報。實際稅務請諮詢專業人士。</div></details>
      <details data-c="fee"><summary>交割可以用台幣嗎？會有匯率成本嗎？</summary><div class="ans">可選擇台幣或外幣交割。台幣交割時系統將自動換匯，會有匯差；若已有美元，可使用外幣帳戶交割以減少換匯成本。</div></details>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="sticky-cta" id="sticky">
  <div><b>新戶交易抽北海道機票</b><small>活動至 2026/12/31</small></div>

<script>
(function(){
  const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
  const fmt = n => 'NT$' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('zh-TW');
  const fmtShort = n => n >= 1e8 ? (n/1e8).toFixed(2)+' 億' : n >= 1e4 ? (n/1e4).toFixed(n>=1e6?0:1)+' 萬' : Math.round(n).toLocaleString();

  /* nav + sticky */
  const nav = $('#nav'), sticky = $('#sticky');
  const onScroll = () => {
    nav.classList.toggle('solid', scrollY > 40);
    sticky.classList.toggle('show', scrollY > 600);
  };
  addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true}); onScroll();

  /* reveal + counters */
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
  }), {threshold:.12});
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => io.observe(el));
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el => {
    const to = +el.dataset.count, pre = el.dataset.prefix||'', suf = el.dataset.suffix||'';
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const step = t => { const p = Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1400), v = to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3));
      el.textContent = pre + Math.round(v).toLocaleString() + suf; if (p<1) requestAnimationFrame(step); };
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  });

  /* market clock */
  function nyParts(d){
    const p = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{timeZone:'America/New_York',hour12:false,weekday:'short',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(d);
    const g = t => p.find(x=>x.type===t).value;
    return {wd:g('weekday'), h:+g('hour')%24, m:+g('minute')};
  }
  function tick(){
    const now = new Date();
    const tw = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-TW',{timeZone:'Asia/Taipei',hour12:false,hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}).format(now);
    const ny = nyParts(now);
    $('#twTime').textContent = tw;
    $('#nyTime').textContent = String(ny.h).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(ny.m).padStart(2,'0');
    const mins = ny.h*60+ny.m, weekday = !['Sat','Sun'].includes(ny.wd);
    // offset NY→TW in hours to show local session
    const twH = +new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{timeZone:'Asia/Taipei',hour12:false,hour:'2-digit'}).format(now)%24;
    let off = (twH - ny.h + 24) % 24; // 12 (夏令) or 13 (冬令)
    const open = (9*60+30+off*60)%1440, close = (16*60+off*60)%1440;
    const hh = m => String(Math.floor(m/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(m%60).padStart(2,'0');
    const twAt = m => hh(((m + off*60) % 1440 + 1440) % 1440);
    $('#mHint').innerHTML = `正常交易時段（台灣時間）<b class="num">${hh(open)} – ${hh(close)}</b>`;
    $('#hPre').textContent = twAt(240) + ' – ' + twAt(570);
    $('#hReg').textContent = twAt(570) + ' – ' + twAt(960);
    $('#hPost').textContent = twAt(960) + ' – ' + twAt(1200);
    let txt, col, seg = null;
    if (weekday && mins>=570 && mins<960){ txt='美股交易中'; col='#E5484D'; seg='reg'; }
    else if (weekday && mins>=240 && mins<570){ txt='盤前交易中・現在就能下單'; col='#FFB81C'; seg='pre'; }
    else if (weekday && mins>=960 && mins<1200){ txt='盤後交易中・現在就能下單'; col='#FFB81C'; seg='post'; }
    else { txt='美股休市中・App 可預約下單'; col='#9AA9A6'; }
    $('#mStatus').textContent = txt; $('#mLight').style.background = col;
    document.querySelectorAll('.seg').forEach(s => s.classList.toggle('on', !!seg && s.classList.contains(seg)));
  }
  tick(); setInterval(tick, 15000);

  /* calculator：標的選擇（ETF / 美國企業地圖） */
  const FX = 32; // 試算用匯率 1 USD ≈ 32 TWD
  const targets = [
    {k:'sp',  n:'S&P 500 ETF', d:'美國大盤・如 VOO', r:10},
    {k:'nq',  n:'那斯達克100 ETF', d:'科技成長・如 QQQ', r:12},
    {k:'div', n:'高股息 ETF',  d:'穩定配息・如 SCHD', r:7},
    {k:'tot', n:'全美市場 ETF', d:'一次買整個美股・如 VTI', r:9.5},
  ];
  // 依企業類型設定的情境假設年化報酬率（非歷史績效、非預測）
  const TIER = {g:{t:'成長型', r:12}, s:{t:'穩健型', r:9}, v:{t:'價值・配息型', r:6}};
  const regions = {
    west:{n:'美西', tag:'科技・創新・娛樂', title:'美西｜科技與創新核心', desc:'加州・華盛頓州：矽谷、南加州與西雅圖的科技、雲端、電商與娛樂巨頭。', c:[
      ['AAPL','Apple','apple.com','iPhone、Mac 與服務生態','g'],['NVDA','NVIDIA','nvidia.com','GPU 與 AI 運算晶片','g'],['MSFT','Microsoft','microsoft.com','Windows、Office 與 Azure','g'],
      ['GOOGL','Alphabet','google.com','搜尋、YouTube 與雲端','g'],['AMZN','Amazon','amazon.com','電子商務與 AWS 雲端','g'],['META','Meta','meta.com','Facebook、IG 與 WhatsApp','g'],
      ['COST','Costco','costco.com','會員制倉儲零售','s'],['DIS','Walt Disney','thewaltdisneycompany.com','影視娛樂、串流與樂園','s'],['SBUX','Starbucks','starbucks.com','全球連鎖咖啡品牌','v']]},
    east:{n:'美東', tag:'金融・生技醫療', title:'美東｜金融、生技醫療與商業', desc:'紐約州・新澤西州・麻薩諸塞州：華爾街金融聚落與東北部生技醫療企業。', c:[
      ['JPM','JPMorgan Chase','jpmorganchase.com','銀行、投資與資產管理','s'],['GS','Goldman Sachs','goldmansachs.com','投資銀行與金融服務','s'],['C','Citigroup','citigroup.com','國際銀行與金融服務','v'],
      ['JNJ','Johnson & Johnson','jnj.com','醫療與製藥企業','v'],['PFE','Pfizer','pfizer.com','全球製藥與生技','v'],['MRNA','Moderna','modernatx.com','mRNA 生技與疫苗研發','g']]},
    south:{n:'美南', tag:'能源・零售・製造', title:'美南｜能源、零售與新興製造', desc:'德州・阿肯色州・喬治亞州：能源與科技製造，搭配南部零售消費企業。', c:[
      ['TSLA','Tesla','tesla.com','電動車與能源產品','g'],['ORCL','Oracle','oracle.com','企業軟體與雲端','g'],['WMT','Walmart','walmart.com','大型零售與電商','s'],
      ['HD','Home Depot','homedepot.com','居家修繕零售','s'],['XOM','ExxonMobil','exxonmobil.com','能源與石化','v'],['KO','Coca-Cola','coca-colacompany.com','飲料與消費品牌','v'],['T','AT&T','att.com','電信與通訊服務','v']]},
    midwest:{n:'美中', tag:'醫療・製造・金融', title:'美中｜醫療、製造與金融投資', desc:'明尼蘇達州・伊利諾州・內布拉斯加州・密西根州：醫療健康、餐飲、汽車與大型控股企業。', c:[
      ['BRK.B','Berkshire Hathaway','berkshirehathaway.com','巴菲特的多元控股公司','s'],['UNH','UnitedHealth','unitedhealthgroup.com','健康保險與醫療服務','s'],['MCD','McDonald’s','mcdonalds.com','全球連鎖餐飲','s'],
      ['ABT','Abbott','abbott.com','醫療器材與診斷','s'],['TGT','Target','target.com','大型綜合零售','v'],['GM','General Motors','gm.com','汽車與移動科技','v'],['F','Ford','ford.com','汽車設計與製造','v']]},
  };
  let sel = {name:'S&P 500 ETF', short:'S&P 500 ETF', tag:'ETF・假設 10%', custom:false};

  function setSel(name, short, tag, rate){
    sel = {name, short, tag, custom:false};
    $('#rate').value = rate; calc();
  }
  const tBox = $('#targets');
  tBox.innerHTML = targets.map((t,i) => `<button class="pill${i===0?' on':''}" data-k="${t.k}">${t.n}<small>${t.d}・假設 ${t.r}%</small></button>`).join('');
  tBox.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const b = e.target.closest('.pill'); if(!b) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('.pill, .companyCard').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on')); b.classList.add('on');
    const t = targets.find(x=>x.k===b.dataset.k);
    setSel(t.n, t.n, `ETF・假設 ${t.r}%`, t.r);
  });

  // 地圖探索
  $('#regionBtns').innerHTML = Object.entries(regions).map(([k,r]) =>
    `<button class="regionBtn" data-region="${k}"><span class="rdot ${k}"></span><b>${r.n}</b><small>${r.tag}</small></button>`).join('');
  function selectRegion(key){
    const r = regions[key];
    document.querySelectorAll('.regionBtn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.region===key));
    document.querySelectorAll('.mapPin, .rg').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('on', p.dataset.region===key));
    $('#rgTitle').textContent = r.title; $('#rgDesc').textContent = r.desc;
    $('#companyList').innerHTML = r.c.map(([tk,n,dom,d,tier]) => `
      <button class="companyCard${sel.short===tk?' on':''}" data-tk="${tk}" data-n="${n}" data-tier="${tier}">
        <span class="logoBox"><img loading="lazy" src="https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=${dom}&sz=64" alt="" onerror="this.remove()"><i>${tk.slice(0,2)}</i></span>
        <span class="cc"><span class="tk">${tk}<em class="tier ${tier}">${TIER[tier].t}</em></span><b>${n}</b><small>${d}</small></span>
      </button>`).join('');
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.regionBtn, .mapPin, .rg').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('click', () => selectRegion(el.dataset.region)));
  $('#companyList').addEventListener('click', e => {
    const b = e.target.closest('.companyCard'); if(!b) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('.pill, .companyCard').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on')); b.classList.add('on');
    const T = TIER[b.dataset.tier];
    setSel(`${b.dataset.tk} ${b.dataset.n}`, b.dataset.tk, `個股・${T.t}・假設 ${T.r}%`, T.r);
  });
  selectRegion('west');

  // 分頁切換
  function showTab(p){
    document.querySelectorAll('.ptab').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on', x.dataset.p===p));
    $('#pEtf').hidden = p!=='etf'; $('#pStock').hidden = p!=='stock';
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.ptab').forEach(t => t.addEventListener('click', () => showTab(t.dataset.p)));

  // 從測驗結果帶入試算標的
  const ETF_OF = {VOO:'sp', QQQ:'nq', SCHD:'div', VYM:'div', VTI:'tot'};
  function pickTarget(tk){
    if (ETF_OF[tk]){
      const t = targets.find(x=>x.k===ETF_OF[tk]);
      showTab('etf');
      document.querySelectorAll('.pill, .companyCard').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on', x.dataset.k===t.k));
      setSel(`${tk}（${t.n}）`, tk, `ETF・假設 ${t.r}%`, t.r);
    } else {
      const key = Object.keys(regions).find(k => regions[k].c.some(c=>c[0]===tk));
      if (!key) return;
      showTab('stock'); selectRegion(key);
      const card = document.querySelector(`.companyCard[data-tk="${tk}"]`); if (card) card.click();
    }
    $('#calc').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
    const bar = $('.selbar'); bar.classList.remove('flash'); void bar.offsetWidth; bar.classList.add('flash');
  }

  ['init','monthly','years','rate'].forEach(id => $('#'+id).addEventListener('input', () => {
    if (id==='rate') sel.custom = true;
    if (id==='monthly' && +$('#monthly').value===50) $('#monthly').value = 100; // 定期定額每期最低 US$100
    calc();
  }));

  function series(init, monthly, years, rate){
    const r = Math.pow(1+rate/100, 1/12)-1, out=[init];
    let v = init;
    for (let m=1; m<=years*12; m++){ v = v*(1+r) + monthly; if (m%12===0) out.push(v); }
    return out;
  }
  function calc(){
    const usd=+$('#monthly').value, monthly=usd*FX;
    const init=+$('#init').value, years=+$('#years').value, rate=+$('#rate').value;
    $('#initOut').textContent = fmt(init);
    $('#monthlyOut').textContent = usd ? 'US$' + usd.toLocaleString() + '（約 ' + fmt(monthly) + '）' : '不設定';
    $('#yearsOut').textContent = years + ' 年';
    $('#rateOut').textContent = rate + '%';
    $('#selName').textContent = sel.name;
    $('#selTag').textContent = sel.custom ? `自訂報酬率 ${rate}%` : sel.tag;
    $('#legName').textContent = sel.short;
    const inv = series(init,monthly,years,rate), dep = series(init,monthly,years,1.7);
    const prin = Array.from({length:years+1},(_,i)=>init+monthly*12*i);
    const fv = inv[years], p = prin[years];
    $('#yrLabel').textContent = years + ' 年後預估資產';
    $('#fv').textContent = fmt(fv);
    $('#principal').textContent = fmt(p);
    $('#gain').textContent = '+' + fmt(fv-p);
    const extra = fv - dep[years];
    const cups = Math.round(monthly/120);
    $('#coffee').innerHTML = monthly
      ? `💡 每月定期定額約 <b>${fmt(monthly)}</b> 投入 <b>${sel.short}</b>，${years} 年後比放定存多出 <b style="color:var(--up)">${fmt(extra)}</b>！`
      : `💡 單筆投入 <b>${sel.short}</b> 並持有 ${years} 年，試算比放定存多出 <b style="color:var(--up)">${fmt(extra)}</b>！`;
    draw(inv, prin, dep);
  }
  function draw(inv, prin, dep){
    const W=640,H=280,pl=56,pr=12,pt=14,pb=28, n=inv.length-1;
    const max = Math.max(...inv)*1.08;
    const x = i => pl + (W-pl-pr)*i/Math.max(n,1), y = v => pt + (H-pt-pb)*(1-v/max);
    const line = a => a.map((v,i)=>(i?'L':'M')+x(i).toFixed(1)+' '+y(v).toFixed(1)).join(' ');
    let g = '';
    for (let i=0;i<=4;i++){ const v=max*i/4, yy=y(v);
      g += `<line x1="${pl}" x2="${W-pr}" y1="${yy}" y2="${yy}" stroke="#E4ECEA"/><text x="${pl-8}" y="${yy+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#7A8E8A">${fmtShort(v)}</text>`; }
    const stepL = Math.ceil(n/6)||1;
    for (let i=0;i<=n;i+=stepL) g += `<text x="${x(i)}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#7A8E8A">${i}年</text>`;
    const area = line(inv) + ` L${x(n)} ${y(0)} L${x(0)} ${y(0)} Z`;
    $('#chart').innerHTML = `<defs><linearGradient id="ga" x1="0" x2="0" y1="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#00877A" stop-opacity=".28"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#00877A" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient></defs>
      ${g}<path d="${area}" fill="url(#ga)"/>
      <path d="${line(prin)}" fill="none" stroke="#B9C4C2" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 5"/>
      <path d="${line(dep)}" fill="none" stroke="#FFB81C" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <path d="${line(inv)}" fill="none" stroke="#00877A" stroke-width="3"/>
      <circle cx="${x(n)}" cy="${y(inv[n])}" r="5" fill="#00877A" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"/>`;
  }
  calc();

  /* quiz */
  const Q = [
    {q:'領到年終獎金，你最可能怎麼做？', o:[['存起來，安全第一',0],['拿一部分投資，其餘備用',1],['大部分投入看好的機會',2]]},
    {q:'如果投資一個月內跌了 20%，你會…', o:[['睡不著，想全部賣掉',0],['先觀察，不急著動作',1],['趁便宜加碼！',2]]},
    {q:'你比較想要哪一種報酬？', o:[['每季穩穩領股息',0],['跟著大盤長期成長',1],['追求高成長，波動也 OK',2]]},
    {q:'你打算這筆錢放多久？', o:[['1-3 年',0],['3-10 年',1],['10 年以上',2]]},
  ];
  const R = [
    {e:'🌿', t:'穩健收息型', d:'你重視穩定與現金流，適合從高股息 ETF 或穩定配息的龍頭股開始，搭配定期定額累積被動收入。', p:[['SCHD','高股息 ETF'],['VYM','高股息 ETF'],['KO','可口可樂・配息股']]},
    {e:'🌳', t:'核心長跑型', d:'你相信時間的力量，以美國大盤 ETF 作為核心，用定期定額穩穩參與全球龍頭成長。', p:[['VOO','S&P 500'],['VTI','全美市場'],['QQQ','那斯達克100']]},
    {e:'🚀', t:'成長衝刺型', d:'你能承受波動、追求高成長，可在大盤 ETF 之外，以定期定額布局科技龍頭。', p:[['QQQ','那斯達克100'],['NVDA','AI 晶片'],['MSFT','雲端 / AI']]},
  ];
  let qi=0, score=0;
  const box = $('#quizBox');
  function renderQ(){
    if (qi>=Q.length) return renderR();
    const it = Q[qi];
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="qbar"><i style="width:${qi/Q.length*100}%"></i></div>
      <div class="qstep">QUESTION ${qi+1} / ${Q.length}</div><div class="qtitle">${it.q}</div>
      <div class="qopts">${it.o.map(([t,s])=>`<button class="qopt" data-s="${s}">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
  }
  function renderR(){
    const avg = score/Q.length, r = R[avg<0.75?0:avg<1.5?1:2];
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="qbar"><i style="width:100%"></i></div><div class="qres">
      <div class="emoji">${r.e}</div><div style="opacity:.7">你的美股投資人格是</div><h3>${r.t}</h3>
      <p style="opacity:.85">${r.d}</p>
      <div style="font-size:13px;opacity:.7">點選標的，帶入下方績效試算</div>
      <div class="picks">${r.p.map(([s,d],i)=>`<button class="pick${i?'':' on'}" data-tk="${s}">${s}<small>${d}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="row"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="toCalc">用 ${r.p[0][0]} 去試算 →</button><a href="#open" class="btn btn-ghost">開戶開始布局</a><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="retry">重新測驗</button></div>
      <p class="disclaim" style="color:rgba(255,255,255,.55)">※ 測驗結果與標的僅供參考，非投資建議；正式投資前請完成風險屬性評估（KYC）。</p></div>`;
    let pickTk = r.p[0][0];
    box.querySelectorAll('.pick').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      pickTk = b.dataset.tk;
      box.querySelectorAll('.pick').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on', x===b));
      $('#toCalc').textContent = `用 ${pickTk} 去試算 →`;
    });
    $('#toCalc').onclick = () => pickTarget(pickTk);
    $('#retry').onclick = () => { qi=0; score=0; renderQ(); };
  }
  box.addEventListener('click', e => { const b=e.target.closest('.qopt'); if(!b) return; score+=+b.dataset.s; qi++; renderQ(); });
  renderQ();

  /* countdown：活動截止 2026/12/31 23:59:59（台灣時間） */
  const end = new Date('2026-12-31T23:59:59+08:00');
  function cd(){
    let s = Math.max(0, (end - new Date())/1000|0);
    const d=s/86400|0; s%=86400; const h=s/3600|0; s%=3600; const m=s/60|0; s%=60;
    [['#cdD',d],['#cdH',h],['#cdM',m],['#cdS',s]].forEach(([id,v])=>$(id).textContent=String(v).padStart(2,'0'));
  }
  cd(); setInterval(cd, 1000);

  /* FAQ filter */
  $('#faqTabs').addEventListener('click', e => {
    const b = e.target.closest('button'); if(!b) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('#faqTabs button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on', x===b));
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq details').forEach(d => d.style.display = (b.dataset.f==='all'||d.dataset.c===b.dataset.f)?'':'none');
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
